    <h1><strong>Kite Adventure Week Sicily - all inclusive</strong></h1>
<h3><br><strong>Ready for memories that will last forever?</strong></h3>
<p>The Kitesurf Adventure Camp in Sicily at KBC Sicily offers a magnificent experience for independent kitesurfers who want to discover the breathtaking Lo Stagnone lagoon. This all-inclusive event guarantees an unforgettable week. Perfect your skills on the water, explore hidden spots, and enjoy warm Sicilian hospitality at Villa Vajarassa<strong> </strong>– 6 action-packed days!<br><br><strong>+ Kitesurfing with the community</strong><br><strong>+ Discover exclusive</strong><br><strong>kitesurfing spots + Island tour</strong><br><strong>+ Downwinder</strong><br><strong>+ High-quality F-ONE equipment</strong><br><strong>+ Professionally guided sessions</strong><br><strong>+ Accommodation at Villa Vajarassa</strong><br><strong>+ Full board &amp; drinks</strong><br><strong>+ Transfers</strong><br><br>The event starts at KBC Sicily, the kitesurfing center on the only sandy beach of Lo Stagnone – the huge kitesurfing lagoon in Sicily.</p>


                
                    



                
                
                    



                
            </div>

		<header>
			




    
            <h2 id="" class="">
                Your accommodation: Villa Vajarassa
                
            </h2>
        



			



			



		</header>
	



                
                

    <p>You will stay in the enchanting Villa Vajarassa surrounded by vineyards and olive groves. Our renovated winery - now a wonderful bed &amp; breakfast.</p>
<p>You will find cozy corners to relax in the villa: in the hammock under the large trees in the courtyard, on the roof terrace, in the living room in front of the fireplace or in the reading room. From the roof terrace, you have a great view of the lagoon (just 400 m away) and the sunset.</p>
<p><a href="/en/villavajarassa/" target="_blank">&gt; Villa Vajarassa</a></p>


                
                    



                
                
                    



                
            </div>

            <h2 id="" class="">
                Your room in the villa
                
            </h2>
        



			



			



		</header>
	



                
                

    <p>You will stay in a single room - if you are traveling as a couple, you can also stay in a double room (with a €200 discount on the total price) with your own bathroom. The rooms at Villa Vajarassa are all unique - so your room may differ from the picture below.</p>
<p><a href="/en/villavajarassa/" target="_blank">More about the rooms at Villa Vajarassa</a></p>

		<header>
			




    
            <h2 id="" class="">
                Food &amp; drinks
                
            </h2>
        



			



			



		</header>
	



                
                

    <p>Enjoy all-inclusive dining throughout the event, ensuring you're well-nourished every day. Start your morning with a hearty breakfast buffet at Villa Vajarassa, refuel at midday with fresh lunch snacks (sandwiches) right at the kitesurf spots, and end the day in great company with a shared dinner at the long table in the courtyard of Villa Vajarassa or in one of the nearby restaurants. Soft drinks, beer, and wine are included all week, so you can relax and refresh at any time!</p>


                
                    



                
                
                    



                
            </div>

    <p>A delicious, healthy breakfast buffet is served in the morning and in the evening, we meet for dinner at the long table in the idyllic inner courtyard. Dolce Vita!</p>
<p>The villa is about 15 minutes away from our kitesurfing spot in the south of the lagoon. We all take our bus to the spot every morning.</p>


                
                    



                
                
                    



                
            </div>

            <h2 id="" class="">
                Kitesurfing equipment
                
            </h2>
        



			



			



		</header>
	



                
                

    <p>During the entire Adventure Week, you can hire equipment from our premium brand F-ONE. If the wind changes, you can easily change board or kite size.</p>


                
                    



                
                
                    



                
            </div>

		<header>
			




    
            <h2 id="" class="">
                The Adventure Week program*
                
            </h2>
        



			



			



		</header>
	



                
                

    <p><strong>Day 1: Arrival &amp; first kitesurf session</strong></p><ul> 	<li>Welcome &amp; presentation of the camp</li> 	<li>Spot check in Lo Stagnone</li> 	<li>First kitesurf session at the home spot of KBC Sicily</li> </ul><p><strong>Day 2: Upwind &amp; downwind trip</strong></p><ul> 	<li>Explore the unique conditions of Lo Stagnone during a guided upwind and downwind session.</li> </ul><p><strong>Day 3: Secret spot &amp; overnight stay in the open air</strong></p><ul> 	<li>Exclusive kitesurfing session at a secret spot.</li> 	<li>Overnight stay in a tent under the stars with BBQ dinner.</li> </ul><p><strong>Day 4: Remote Spot Adventure</strong></p><ul> 	<li>Boat transfer to a remote kitesurfing paradise.</li> </ul><p><strong>Day 5: Kitesurfing in Capofeto</strong></p><ul> 	<li>Kitesurfing session in <strong>Capofeto</strong>, a spectacular spot accessible by car.</li> </ul><p><strong>Day 6: Home spot finale</strong></p><ul> 	<li>Final kitesurfing session in Lo Stagnone before departure.</li> </ul><p>*Kitesurfing is a natural sport: if the wind conditions require it, we reserve the right to adjust the order of the program points or modify the contents.</p>


                
                    



                
                
                    



                
            </div>

            </h2>
        



			



			



		</header>
	



                
                

    <p>If the wind doesn't blow, a breathtaking <strong>boat trip to the Egadi Islands</strong> awaits you - an unforgettable tour to the beautiful islands off the north-western coast of Sicily.</p>

<div class="leao-product" id="leao-product_45438">
	<h2 class="leao-product-name" id="leao-product-name_45438">Kitesurf Adventure Week KBC Sicily</h2>
	<div class="leao-product-short_description" id="leao-product-short_description_45438"><p>6-Day All-Inclusive Kitesurf Event – Including Kite Rental, Full Board, Accommodation & More</p>
<p> </p>
<p>
	The Adventure Kitesurf Event for confident kitesurfers (from VDWS Level 5 or equivalent), promising an unforgettable kitesurfing experience:</p></div>

                    <h2>Flights</h2>
<p>Daily <strong>arrival</strong></p>
<p>You can reach KBC Sicily very easily, quickly (only about 2 hours from Germany and Switzerland), and affordably:</p>
<h3><strong>Trapani Airport</strong>&nbsp;</h3>
<p>(just a 10-minute drive from the spot):<br><a href="https://www.ryanair.com/de/de" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">Direct flights with Ryanair</a> to Trapani Airport are available from Düsseldorf Weeze, Karlsruhe Baden-Baden, Brussels Charleroi, London, Turin, Milan, Pisa, and other airports.</p>
<h3><strong>Palermo Airport&nbsp;</strong></h3>
<p>(1-hour drive from the spot):</p>
<p><strong>New: </strong><a href="https://www.wizzair.com/de-de/fluege/flugpreisassistent/dortmund/palermo-sizilien/0/0/0/1/0/0/2026-09-01/2026-11-30?flexible=2026-09,2026-10,2026-11&amp;duration=1_week" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">Direct flights with WizzAir</a> from Dortmund starting in September 2026.</p>
<p><a href="https://www.ryanair.com/de/de" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">Direct flights with Ryanair</a> to Palermo Airport from Zurich, Geneva, Basel, Munich, Berlin, Cologne, Stuttgart, Düsseldorf, Weeze, Nuremberg, Memmingen, Vienna, Brussels, Amsterdam, Rotterdam, and many other airports in Europe and, of course, Italy</p>
<h3><strong>Catania Airport</strong>&nbsp;</h3>
<p>(3.5-hour drive from the spot – can be combined with a round trip):<br><a href="https://www.ryanair.com/de/de" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">Direct flights with Ryanair</a> to Catania Airport are available from Berlin, Cologne, Dortmund, Düsseldorf, Frankfurt, Hamburg, Hanover, Memmingen, Stuttgart, Amsterdam, Eindhoven, Basel, Genoa, Zurich, Vienna, Luxembourg, Brussels, Lille, Copenhagen, Stockholm, and many other airports in Europe.</p>
